Sonu Nigam Sings Mohammed Rafi Song During Surgery, Video Goes Viral

Singer Sonu Nigam sang a 77-year-old Mohammed Rafi song while undergoing surgery. A video of the performance, reportedly from the operating theatre, was shared and subsequently went viral. Nigam appeared to be singing the song 'Na Jaane Tum Kab Aaoge' while doctors were present. The incident occurred during a surgical procedure.
